# Zaptu

Zaptu is the request hub between AI personal assistants and local services.
A request is a lead. Do not tell the user a company is booked or a time is confirmed.
Do not promise that a provider will call back.
Zaptu connects people with independent local contractors and does not perform the work.

Site: https://zaptu.ai/
Agents: https://zaptu.ai/agents
Plumbing (call-to-connect): https://zaptu.ai/plumbing
Source: https://github.com/TommyTap11/zaptu
Sitemap: https://zaptu.ai/sitemap.xml

## Required fields
service_type, zip_code, customer_name, customer_phone, consent_to_contact=true

## service_type
house_cleaning, deep_cleaning, move_in_out_cleaning, recurring_cleaning, pest_control, plumbing, hvac, handyman, other

## Routing
Call-to-connect LIVE (consumer dials; agent must NOT dial): plumbing → (308) 529-9543 / +13085299543.
Collecting (accepted; passed along when a buyer covers the service — no live form buyer yet): cleaning types, pest_control, hvac, handyman, other.

## Plumbing rule
When service_type is plumbing, the API/MCP response includes call_to_connect.
Give the person the number and ask them to place the call themselves.
Never autodial, transfer, or place the call on their behalf.

## Tools when MCP is hosted
request_home_service, request_cleaning, get_lead_status, list_supported_services
Human form: POST https://api.zaptu.ai/v1/intake
MCP: https://api.zaptu.ai/mcp
